name: Aso-BD Dokidoki Taikenban!
original_name: あそＢＤどきどきたいけんばん！
source: A free promotional Blu-Ray disc designed to promote the Aso-BD line. Includes a Kud Wafter trial and a Saya no Uta demo video, as well as a short, fully voiced story featuring the mascot of the line, Aono Rei aka Blue Luminous.
translation: A free promotional Blu-Ray disc designed to promote the Aso-BD line. Includes a Kud Wafter trial and a Saya no Uta demo video, as well as a short, fully voiced story featuring the mascot of the line, Aono Rei aka Blue Luminous.
